description: React component for rendering a row in the admin console's group settings, specifically for managing team and channel memberships, roles, and collapse/expand functionality.

classes.name: GroupTeamsAndChannelsRow
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing a row representing a team or channel in the admin console.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles removal of the team or channel membership, triggers onRemoveItem callback and closes confirmation modal.

methods.name: changeRoles
methods.description: Toggles the role between member and admin for the team or channel.

methods.name: toggleCollapse
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the row if it has children.

methods.name: displayAssignedRolesDropdown
methods.description: Renders a dropdown menu for changing the role (member or admin) of the team or channel.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the table row with icons, name, type, role dropdown, and remove button, including confirmation modal.
